spans.s: लेश Adj. Masc. only. (-शः) Small, little.

. Smallness, littleness.
2. A little.
 3. A particular measure of time equal to two

. Name of a figure of speech, (in rhetoric.)
 E. लिश् to be small,
aff. घञ्. Some authorities vary the gender of the attribute.

लेष्टु m. (-ष्टुः) A clod of earth.
 E. लिश् to become less or small, तुन् Unādi aff.

लेष्टुघ्न m. (-घ्नः) A harrow.
 E. लेष्टु a clod of earth, and घ्न destroying.
लेसिक m. (-कः) The rider on an elephant, who sits on the animal's loins.
